name: Isurugi Hayato
source:
A hot-blooded, good-hearted young man with an infinite well of kindness and a strong sense of justice, he is unfortunately not blessed with any real talent for spiritual arts other than body-strengthening.  Doomed to mediocrity but not really bothered by it, his meeting with Shion changes his life while also providing a purpose that drives him.  

[spoiler]The powers he is granted by Shion include a mystic eye that allows him to see through others' spellcasting and a spear that purifies corruption.  He also quietly possesses a unique hidden art that he isn't aware of that allows him to sense when others are suffering and want someone to reach out to them.[/spoiler]
